changeSet.sql: SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('loans', 'loan_id'), GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(loan_id) FROM loans), 0) + 1, nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('loans', 'loan_id'))), false); UPDATE loans SET created_at = COALESCE(created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), created_by = COALESCE(created_by, 'system') WHERE created_at IS NULL OR created_by IS NULL;
